comparison.objective: Engage a chainsaw brake and fit its bar cover; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Guard actuation and long cover alignment/insertion versus small-tool engagement, fine rotary adjustment, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Brake engaged, cover over at least 95% of bar, arms clear, and saw unmoved versus two safe damper cycles with no bottoming or drift.
comparison.reason: Different safety mechanism, manipulation, and measured result.
